title: EU is bankrolling border drones while starving the watchdogs meant to stop abuses
lede: Millions of euros of EU funds are being pumped into shoring-up border surveillance while legally-required national human-rights monitors struggle with funding. Some EU states still don't have any monitors - despite a June deadline.

title: EU ‘open’ to curbs on imports of Chinese chemicals and machinery, after hybrid-car deal
lede: The European Commission “showed openness” to proposing trade "safeguards", a brake on imports that can cover entire sectors, such as chemicals and machinery.
